settings.binding: LabelServices.Configure binds Sample:Execution and validates a positive supported duration before effects.
settings.description: Complete operation I/O safeguard; the sample runtime owns the thirty-second default, with configured positive durations limited to uint.MaxValue - 1 milliseconds.

semanticConstraints: Timeout must be positive and no greater than uint.MaxValue - 1 milliseconds. It caps the complete operation, not each individual provider call.
